messages:
lena_sec: Heads-up: customer-facing pen-test scheduled Tue 07:30-11:30 PT. We need a concise runbook covering RBAC snapshot, KMS/HSM constraints, evidence redaction rules (PII/PCI), and a retest gating timeline. Keep it <1 page.

omar_ops: I'll take lockbox + presign work. Plan: presigned POST to `redwood-pt-evidence` with bucket default CMK. No kms:GenerateDataKey for assessor principals. Multipart required >100MB.

rita_platform: RBAC snapshot: export roles/tags/policies at T0 with small script. I'll add a note to include Okta/SAML assertions snapshot for federated roles. Store `iam-snapshot-<ptid>.json` next to archive.

ben_sre: For traceability, tag minted STS creds with `pen_test_id=<ptid>` and `actor=assessor`. We'll capture `aws sts get-caller-identity` during uploads and store the output.

hsm-bot: Reminder from KMS team: if uploads include SSE-KMS headers the client needs kms:Encrypt; to avoid that, use bucket default encryption with CMK and do not include SSE headers in presign. HSM key wraps remain ops-only.

lena_sec: Evidence redaction: assessors must mark any artifacts containing PHI/PCI as "sensitive" in the manifest and we will handle redaction offline. Allowed filetypes: tgz, zip, pcap, json. Max single object 8GB. Naming: `<ptid>/<assessor>/<YYYYMMDD_HHMM>_<sha256>.<ext>`.

omar_ops: Also note: we'll deny `s3:GetObject` in the assessor policy so they can't list other prefixes. Only S3:PutObject and S3:ListBucket limited to their prefix.

rita_platform: Audit exports: run CloudTrail (+ filter on pen_test_id tag), collect host journals for in-scope hosts, and dump IAM snapshot. Sample snippet I'll add to ticket: ```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time "2026-06-01T06:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-06-01T14:00:00Z" > cloudtrail.json
aws s3 cp cloudtrail.json s3://redwood-pt-exports/<ptid>/
``` Then bundle: `tar -czf <ptid>-archive.tgz cloudtrail.json iam-snapshot.json host-journal.log` and sha256 it.

ben_sre: Retest gates: critical -> emergency retest within 48h after fix deploy + smoke test by SRE; high -> 72h mitigation window then retest; medium/low -> schedule 7-14 days. Retest requires PR/commit referencing SEC ticket + CI evidence.

hsm-bot: KMS policy note: operations will own CMK key policy. No external principals will be granted key access. All encryption via bucket default.

lena_sec: Action items: @omar_ops create presign gateway for pt prefix, @rita_platform add IAM & SAML snapshot script, @ben_sre add pt_id tagging to STS mint, and I'll draft 1-page runbook and a customer-facing remediation template. Dry-run: mint + upload 24h prior. Objections?

omar_ops: No objections. I'll post sample curl + JS snippet in staging by EOD.

security-bot: Created SEC-2026-2501 "Pen-test runbook: RBAC, KMS/HSM constraints, evidence redaction, retest SLA" (assignee: lena_sec; due: 2026-06-05). :clipboard:

lena_sec: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping me or escalate to the incident channel. :lock!
